newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Bahrain 91-day treasury bill rate falls slightly.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain 91-day treasury bill rate falls slightly.

text.p: The average rate at this week's tender for 10 million dinars worth of 91-day Bahrain treasury bills dropped slightly to 5.48 percent from last week's 5.49 percent, a Bahrain Monetary Agency spokesman said on Monday.
The average price rose slightly to 98.633 from 98.632 last week. The minumum price accepted was 98.629.
Banks submitted bids for 20.6 million dinars worth of bills, down from 21.9 a week ago.
The bills are offered on Monday and issued on Wednesday.
